test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a public sector bank?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South Indian Bank**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **South Indian Bank** is a private-sector bank, which means it is not owned by the government. 
 
• It is headquartered in Thrissur, Kerala, and operates primarily in the southern states of India.
 
• Unlike public sector banks, which are owned by the government, private sector banks are owned by private individuals or corporations.
 
• They operate independently and are not directly controlled by the government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Corporation Bank, Indian Overseas Bank, and UCO Bank** are all **public sector banks** in India.
 
• This means they are owned by the Government of India.
 
• They are part of the Indian banking system and offer a range of banking services to individuals and businesses.
 
• Public sector banks are often seen as more stable and reliable due to their government backing.
 
• They play a crucial role in the Indian economy, particularly in areas like rural banking and financial inclusion.
